title: Oracle Against Damascus

questions.question: Behold, Damascus will cease to be a city and will become a heap of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:1 (ESV): "and will become a heap of ruins."

questions.question: The fortress will disappear from Ephraim, and the kingdom from where?
And the glory of Jacob will be brought low, and the fat of his flesh will grow what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:4 (ESV): "and the fat of his flesh will grow lean."

questions.question: In that day man will look to his Maker, and his eyes will look on the Holy One of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:7 (ESV): "and his eyes will look on the Holy One of Israel."

questions.question: For you have forgotten the God of your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:10 (ESV): "For you have forgotten the God of your salvation"

questions.question: And have not remembered the Rock of your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:10 (ESV): "and have not remembered the Rock of your refuge;"

questions.question: Therefore, though you plant pleasant plants and sow the vine-branch of a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:10 (ESV): "and sow the vine-branch of a stranger,"

questions.question: Though you make them blossom in the morning that you sow, yet the harvest will flee away in a day of grief and incurable what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:11 (ESV): "in a day of grief and incurable pain."

questions.question: Ah, the thunder of many peoples; they thunder like the thundering of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:12 (ESV): "they thunder like the thundering of the sea!"

questions.question: Ah, the roar of nations; they roar like the roaring of mighty what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:12 (ESV): "they roar like the roaring of mighty waters!"

questions.question: The nations roar like the roaring of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:13 (ESV): "but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far away,"

questions.question: Chased like chaff on the mountains before the wind and whirling dust before the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:13 (ESV): "and whirling dust before the storm."

questions.question: At evening time, behold, terror! Before morning, they are what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:14 (ESV): "Before morning, they are no more."

questions.question: This is the portion of those who loot us, and the lot of those who what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:14 (ESV): "and the lot of those who plunder us."

questions.question: Gleanings will be left in it, as when an olive tree is beaten—two or three berries in the top of the highest what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 17:6 (ESV): "two or three berries in the top of the highest bough,"

key_verse_text: In that day man will look to his Maker, and his eyes will look on the Holy One of Israel.
